title: Dossier pages flat: the integrated-dossier hero, fact cells, notes, table and glossary on /dossier and /stichting become ruled sections and left-ruled asides
first: Map: docs/masthead-campaign.md, section 'Cards: inventory and cuts (map revision 3)'. Ruling: operator-no-cards-except-floats. --gamecult-rule exists after home-flat. Line numbers from 410485e; re-read by selector. The portfolio-dossier block (2515-2725) is dead and is deleted in dead-card-css, not here.

Pages: GameCult/dossier.md and GameCult/stichting.md (cssclasses integrated-dossier-page; scripts/render-integrated-dossier.mjs emits the same classes). Surfaces in the .integrated-dossier-page block and after it: .integrated-dossier-hero (2779-2790: border, radius 8px, gradient fill, shadow, big padding); the shared card rule for .integrated-dossier-hero dl div, .integrated-dossier-note, .integrated-dossier-table, .integrated-dossier-glossary (2824-2831: border, radius, fill); dl div padding (2833-2835); note padding and shadow (2852-2856); .integrated-dossier-lead border-color (2862-2864); the table's own display/overflow rules (2866-2898: the engine's th/tr hairlines already separate rows; no change needed to those); glossary padding (2900-2902).

Mechanism: the hero is type on the ground closed by a bottom rule; each dl cell is a ruled column (top rule, like the project fact row); a note is a left-ruled aside in the dossier's blue (the lead note in orange), like the engine's blockquote; the table is the engine's table (rows ruled by th/tr); the glossary is a dl whose dt rows carry the top rule.
The dossier's own tokens (--integrated-panel, --integrated-panel-soft, --integrated-border) lose their last readers in this cut and are deleted; --integrated-blue and --integrated-orange stay.

deletes.note: 2779-2790 .integrated-dossier-hero: border, border-radius, background (3 lines), box-shadow (3 lines) deleted; margin stays; padding replaced (adds).
2824-2831: the shared card rule (dl div, note, table, glossary: border, radius, background) deleted whole.

keeps_moves: The dossier type rules (2734-2777: Ubuntu 300 body, Montserrat headings, h2 bottom rule in --integrated-border -> becomes var(--gamecult-rule) at 2750), kicker/source, h1, lead paragraph, dl grid (2817-2822), dt/dd type (2837-2850), note strong colour, table display/overflow/tbody/th/td rules (2866-2898), glossary dd + dt spacing: unchanged except the token swap.
The two markdown files and the render script: unchanged.
adds: custom.scss .integrated-dossier-hero dl div: padding: 0.6rem 0 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--gamecult-rule); (replacing padding 0.8rem 0.9rem)

custom.scss .integrated-dossier-note: padding: 0.1rem 0 0.1rem 1rem; border-left: 2px solid var(--integrated-blue); (replacing padding 1rem 1.1rem and the shadow). .integrated-dossier-lead: border-left-color: var(--integrated-orange); (replacing border-color).

custom.scss .integrated-dossier-glossary: padding: 0; and .integrated-dossier-glossary dt { padding-top: 0.6rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--gamecult-rule); } with the existing dd + dt margin-top 1rem reduced to 0.6rem.
custom.scss 2750: article h2 border-bottom colour var(--gamecult-rule) in place of var(--integrated-border).

file_changes.change: hero: box deleted; bottom rule and padding written.
shared card rule deleted; dl cell top rule, note left rule, lead colour written.

authority_map.owner: custom.scss owns the dossier pages' grouping through --gamecult-rule and the two dossier accents; the markdown (and the render script that emits it) owns the content and section order.
inputs: the dossier markup's hero, dl, note, table and glossary
outputs: /dossier and /stichting as ruled sections: hero closed by a rule, ruled fact cells, left-ruled notes, the engine's table, a ruled glossary
derived_state: every separator on the dossier pages is derived from --gamecult-rule; the dossier's own border and panel tokens are gone
forbidden_writers: no background, border-radius or box-shadow on any .integrated-dossier-* element; no border other than border-top on dl div and dt, border-bottom on the hero and h2, border-left on notes, and the engine's th/tr rules
no change to the markdown, the render script, the pills, the masthead or the engine
shared_paths: the same token and left-rule treatment as the rest of the site; the same Deploy Quartz workflow
authority_map.deletion_line: The hero box, the shared card rule, the note shadow and the three tokens are deleted before the rule declarations are written.

builds: Deploy Quartz green on the landing commit: gh run list -R GameCult/gamecult-site -w "Deploy Quartz" -L 1
